EXPERIENCE
Tavant Technologies, Bangalore – Data Scientist March 2021 – Present
Claims Review Copilot – Designed and deployed a multi-agent AI system using Python, LangGraph, LangChain, and RAG, deployed on Azure Web Apps, to assist in claims analysis. The system predicts the most suitable QA codes (Defect, Remedy, Symptom), identifies correlations among comments, assesses issue severity, recommends new QA codes, summarizes incidents, and generates suspect scores to classify claims as suspicious or non-suspicious. The integrated output supports claim processors in making final acceptance or denial decisions.
Data Science Agentic AI – Machine Learning Lifecycle
Designed and implemented an AI-agent–driven machine learning lifecycle using Python, Autogen Framework, and LLM GPT-4o, integrating exploratory data analysis, preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation agents. Each stage was powered by modular sub-agents to automate data handling, reporting, and execution. The system included a preprocessing agent for streamlined data preparation, a feature engineering agent for optimized feature generation, and a model performance comparison. This end-to-end agentic solution architecture provides a approach for building robust machine learning workflows.
Triage Based AI Intelligent Search - Developed an Agentic AI solution integrating LangGraph, Langchain, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI (GPT models), RAG, GEN AI, Python to enhance field service support through intelligent search and retrieval. Structured data from Azure SQL and unstructured data such as manuals from Blob Storage were indexed using embeddings for semantic search. The system interprets technician queries, reformulates them when necessary, and retrieves the most relevant service reports. It identifies recent service tickets and recommends troubleshooting steps, replacement parts, and appropriate manuals by matching embeddings from prior reports and documents.
Fraud Detection in Claim Filing – Built and deployed a Machine Learning model in Azure (via MLOps CI/CD pipeline), Azure ML Studio to detect fraudulent claims by generating a suspect score that classifies claims as suspicious or non-suspicious.
